title: Build a Responsive Landing Page
shortDescription: Create a mobile-first landing page for a short film platform.
fullDescription: Build a responsive landing page using HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript. It should have a hero section, a featured films grid and a newsletter form.
requirements:
Hero section with call to action
Featured films grid with at least 6 cards
Newsletter form with email validation
acceptanceCriteria:
Page is usable on a 360px wide screen
Email field shows an error for invalid input
Lighthouse accessibility score of 90 or more
expectedDeliverables:
Public GitHub repository
README with setup steps

title: REST API for Film Submissions
shortDescription: Create a small REST API to accept and list film submissions.
fullDescription: Build a Node.js and Express API with MongoDB. Support creating a submission, listing submissions with pagination and fetching one submission by id.
requirements:
POST /submissions creates a record
GET /submissions supports page and limit
Input is validated
acceptanceCriteria:
Invalid input returns a 400 with a clear message
Pagination returns total and pages
README documents every endpoint
expectedDeliverables:
Public GitHub repository
Postman collection or curl examples

title: Admin Dashboard with Charts
shortDescription: Build a dashboard that shows submission statistics.
fullDescription: Create a React dashboard that fetches statistics from a mock API and shows a line chart, a bar chart and a summary table.
requirements:
Line chart of submissions per week
Bar chart by category
Loading and error states
acceptanceCriteria:
Charts update when the date filter changes
No TypeScript errors
Components have basic tests
expectedDeliverables:
Public GitHub repository
Short demo GIF in the README
